Add Row.description: Inserts one row into a CARTO table, e.g. a geolocated health facility or case report.

Insert Point With SQL.description: Inserts a row with a point geometry using the SQL API.

Update Rows With SQL.description: Updates existing rows, e.g. the status of a water point.

Query Rows Near a Point.description: Finds rows within a distance of a location, e.g. facilities within 5 km of a household.

Aggregate by Area.description: Counts rows per district, e.g. for a map of case counts.
